insights.title: Macro Unit Volume Expansion
insights.finding: Total units sold expanded from [FIG01_2013_UNITS]M in 2013 to [FIG01_2015_UNITS]M in 2015, alongside a contraction in zero-sales rows.
insights.implication: Global trend features must be included to capture baseline expansion separate from seasonality.

insights.title: Day-of-Week Weekend Surges
insights.finding: Retail patterns are weekend-heavy, with Store Type A demonstrating a Saturday index of 128.0.
insights.implication: Models must utilize robust day-of-week embeddings to capture intra-week cyclicality.

insights.title: Bi-Monthly Quincena (Payday) Spikes
insights.finding: Public sector payrolls drive mid-month (Index: 97.6) and month-end (Index: 103.2) demand spikes, which spill heavily into the 1st of the next month (Index: 111.7).
insights.implication: Day-of-month embeddings or explicit payday boolean flags are critical for peak prediction.

insights.title: 2016 Manabí Earthquake Reallocation
insights.finding: Post-earthquake, emergency staples surged by +118.2% over pre-quake baselines.
insights.implication: The 30-day linear earthquake_decay feature is essential to prevent models from learning the shock as permanent seasonality.

insights.title: Holiday Lead Anticipation
insights.finding: The day preceding a holiday (is_holiday_tomorrow) generates an average volume uplift of +5.11%.
insights.implication: Future-looking calendar flags are required to capture anticipation buying prior to event-day store closures.

insights.title: Store 52 Pre-Opening Anomaly
insights.finding: Store 52 contributes 51,810 structural grid zeros before opening on 2017-04-20.
insights.implication: Pre-opening zeros must be masked during training loss calculation to prevent suppressing baseline forecasts.

insights.title: Product Family Pareto Concentration
insights.finding: The top 3 categories account for 62.43% of total volume, with extreme sparsity in the long tail.
insights.implication: Loss functions should be resilient to zero-inflation (e.g., RMSLE or Tweedie) rather than standard MSE.

insights.title: Geographic Volume Distribution
insights.finding: Store Cluster 5 moves 8.82x more volume than Cluster 7.
insights.implication: Hierarchical modeling or cluster-level embeddings are needed to scale predictions across varying geographic baselines.
